title: The Basketball Game
content: Last Friday, our class had a basketball game against Class Two. Everyone was excited. My best friend Zhang Wei is on our team. He practices basketball every day after school, so he plays very well. The game started at 4:00 p.m. At first, Class Two was winning. Their captain, Da Ming, is a tall and strong player. But our team didn't give up. With five minutes left, Zhang Wei scored three points and helped us win. We were so happy that we jumped and cheered. After the game, we bought some ice cream for Zhang Wei. He is really a hero in our heart.

questions.q: When did the basketball game take place?
questions.explain: 细节理解题。根据第一句Last Friday, our class had a basketball game against Class Two.可知，比赛是在上周五，选B。

questions.q: Why does Zhang Wei play basketball well?
options: A. He is tall and strong
C. His father is a coach
questions.explain: 细节理解题。根据文中He practices basketball every day after school, so he plays very well.可知，他每天练习所以球打得好，选B。

questions.q: What can we infer from the passage?
options: A. Our team won the game easily
B. Da Ming is on our team
C. We were disappointed after the game
D. Teamwork and never giving up are important
questions.explain: 推理判断题。根据文中But our team didn't give up. With five minutes left, Zhang Wei scored...可知，不放弃和团队合作很重要，选D。

questions.q: What does the underlined word "scored" mean in Chinese?
questions.explain: 词义猜测题。根据上下文，scored three points意为得三分，选B。
